verdict.rationale: Stable documents webhook endpoints, configured in the dashboard, that notify you about 'important events' on your account. Its mailbox product also offers Slack and email alerts for new mail. However, the evidence never says which events fire, so new-mail and scan-complete webhooks are only implied. Location status changes are documented as requiring polling. Missing for 10: an explicit list of webhook event types confirming new-mail and scan-completed events, payload and signing docs, a Zapier integration, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
